title: Stock Certificate (Historical)

origin.publisher: Wikimedia Commons (photograph by Julie Ceccaldi; certificate from the Sammlung Commodore, Rüdiger K. Weng)
origin.title: Stock certificate No. 95, The Ford Motor Company of Canada, Limited, issued November 10, 1908
origin.clearance_note: A 1908 Ford Motor Company of Canada stock certificate, photographed and released on Wikimedia Commons under CC0 (public domain dedication). Downloaded by script as a 4080x3308 JPEG and wrapped in a one-page PDF with no metadata. Published as printed under the historical-record exemption. Evidence: the certificate is dated 1908 on its face and in the Commons record (DateTimeOriginal 1908-11-10), more than 72 years ago; the holder, James Couzens (Ford co-founder, later US Senator, died 1936), the president, Henry Ford (died 1947), and the secretary, Gordon M. McGregor (founder of Ford of Canada, died 1922), are deceased public figures acting in their corporate roles. The request named a Getty Images photograph of Henry Ford's 1903 Ford Motor Company certificate hosted by Investopedia; it was replaced with this CC0 source at the operator's direction because the Getty image is licensed, not released for reuse.

notes: The request named a Getty Images photo of Henry Ford's 1903 Ford Motor Company certificate (via Investopedia). The operator chose this CC0 Commons certificate instead, since the Getty image is licensed rather than released for reuse. No feature page or fields were requested. The overlay follows the issue of certificate No. 95: its number, the shareholder, the ten shares written out by hand, where it was issued, and Henry Ford's signature as president. Named individuals are featured because a stock certificate's substance is who holds it and who signed it, and here they are Ford's founders, all long deceased. Two extraction errors are documented in the README: the issue date and the cancellation mark.
